programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: If there is one thing that every gearhead dreams of doing, it’s getting their car out on the open road and opening it up to see how fast it will go. Of course, there are a few things like speed limits, tickets, and jail time that keep people from doing this sort of thing. But, wouldn’t it be great if it was possible to do it just once? Well it is... and today Stacey shows you where as we showcase the last real outlaw race in the country… the Silver State Classic road race. If you have a car, and the desire to drive it fast, then there is 90 miles of wide open, two-lane highway in Nevada calling your name! Then it’s back to the GEARZ shop where Stacey addresses one of the most versatile tools you can have in your shop… the MIG welder.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: If you’ve been around cars and trucks very long, you know that vintage, nostalgia, and rat rods are very popular. The question is, how do you make a nostalgia-style car with leaf springs hook up like a modern drag car but not lose the vintage look? Simple… you install a ladder bar system! But how do you keep the leaf springs from binding you ask? Ah... there is a special way to do it, and if you want to find out what it is …you need to catch this episode of GEARZ. Then it’s out on the road to test it out as Stacey shows you just how much fun you can have with a nostalgia-style vehicle. Would somebody please bail him out of jail?!?

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: One of the most frustrating things that can happen when you are building a project is finding out the parts you need are no longer available. This can usually bring the project to a screeching halt! But all is not lost because there is another option and Stacey walks you through the ins and outs of hunting for those elusive parts in a salvage yard. After that, it’s back to the shop where Stacey shows you how to restore those old, rag-tag parts that you find. It’s auto recycling at its best, and with today’s economy, it’s also a smart thing to do!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Rat Roaster is back!... and this wild little ’32 Roadster gets even wilder as Stacey starts adding some cool details to lock it into the Hot Rod and Rock and Roll culture of 1969. A cool microphone shifter with a touch of James Bond, a bass drum kick pedal, bobbed fenders and a wild custom Gibson guitar to go with the car are just part of it. There is also a special appearance by legendary bass player, Billy Cox, as he talks about playing Woodstock with Jimi Hendrix. After that, Stacey gives you the low-down on the plasma cutter and why you need one. If you like shows that are laced with equal amounts of cool and history, then this episode of GEARZ is one you HAVE to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Some of the biggest news to come down the automotive pipeline in a long time is the fact that Dodge is making the Challenger again. But how does it stack up against the legendary Challengers of old? Well, Stacey decides to find out! First, by “grabbing” a Challenger in a most unorthodox way and then comparing it head-to-head with a 70’ 440 six-pack car. But that’s not all… Then Stacey decides to take the new car beyond the legend by sticking on a supercharger and really blowing the doors off of the competition! If you are a Mopar nut, or have just wondered what all the fuss was about concerning the new Challenger…this is one show you’ve got to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: With the price of gas going up, down, and all over the place, people are becoming more and more concerned about fuel economy, and GEARZ is asked time and time again what products we recommend that really give you better economy and performance. Well, ask no more…because Stacey not only addresses that question, but also goes through the top 6 upgrades that ANYBODY can do to a vehicle! That’s right; these are inexpensive AND easy to do! After that, Stacey takes on the subject of alternative fuels by demonstrating that you can actually make a diesel engine run, and run well, on old used cooking oil! Now there is yet another reason to eat French fries! So pass the ketchup and put the hammer down!!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Every once in a while, there comes a point in your project where there are no parts available to help you, and your only choice is to make something yourself… but how do you do that? Stacey walks you through the steps of how to lay out an engine swap, and how to hand fabricate motor mounts, so you can stick an engine into a vehicle that it was never intended to go into. It’s hard-core, down and dirty how-to, but somebody has to do it… and it needs to be YOU. The good news is, with Stacey walking you through the process and showing you how to solve problems, it CAN be you! Now you just need to get out in the garage and start working!!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Everybody knows that the engine is a central key component to ANY Hot Rod project. But is a V8 the only way to go? NO WAY! Stacey takes a vintage straight six engine that has been sleeping in a crate for almost 40 years and he puts on the right pieces. He shows you why the straight six was a force to be reckoned with in the early days of hot rodding. After that, Stacey jumps into the tips and tricks of how to paint your own true Kandy paint job. If you are into vintage Hot Rods, Kandy paint, and multi-carbs… you don’t need to go on a diet… you just need to watch GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The “KnuckleBuster” is back on GearZ, and Stacey is putting the final touches on this ’73 Chevy pickup. After a quick look at the new paint slathered on its flanks, Stacey gives the truck a face lift with grille, bumpers, and all that other cool trim stuff. Then it’s on to the bed where he lays in some oak to give the former “beater” some class and style. Finally, it’s underneath to stick in a new exhaust system to keep the bad gas blowing out the back. If you have ever wondered if you could really build something cool yourself… all you have to do is check out the finished “KnuckleBuster” and be willing to bust YOUR own knuckles… the rest will take care of itself!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: POP QUIZ… what are the 16 most influential cars ever made? If you answered Ford, Chevy, VW, Honda, or any other car manufacturer, you are close…but wrong! The 16 most influential cars ever made were the 16 original Hot Wheel cars that Mattel rolled out in 1968. Stacey walks you through the fascinating and unique story of how those little metal cars came to be and how they changed American car culture in a HUGE way. Young or old, you will love the story about the cars that turned living rooms across the country into huge racetracks. Matter-of-fact, we’ll bet you not only remember these cars, but you probably owned a few of them over the years. So, dig out the toy box and put the chores on hold because it’s time to do some Hot Wheels racin’!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: When it comes to off-road vehicles, more is usually better. This is especially true when tires are involved. Today on GEARZ, Stacey takes you through the nuts and bolts of one of the most incredible off-road vehicles ever built…the Gamma Goat. What!?! You’ve never heard of it? Well that’s probably because you were not in the military. Because only the military could dream up an articulating, six-wheel-drive, amphibious monster like this, and still keep it street legal! After that, Stacey walks you through some important safety tips and tricks that you need to know if you are going to be welding in your shop…so lock and load and strap in ‘cuz it’s all coming at you today on GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: Stacey goes where all of us have been before to pull an old derelict SEMI TRUCK(’69 International) out of a quiet junkyard to demonstrate the steps necessary to get an old, neglected vehicle running again. From rat’s nests to chicken poop, it’s all here as Stacey slowly coaxes the old truck back to life. This show definitely drives the point home that if something like this can be revived, there’s NOTHING that you should be afraid to tackle as long as you are armed with a set of tools and a sense of adventure! Go get ‘em !

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: The Speed Racer Story and the Real Mach 5
programme.desc: Stacey digs into one of the most influential cars and cartoons in our history -- Speed Racer and the Mach 5. This show not only takes you thru the history of the cartoon, but also its cultural impact on multi-generations as well. But that’s not all, Stacey manages to “borrow” the real Mach 5 and put it thru the paces against Racer X and other challengers. If you’ve never crossed the line between fact and fiction, real and imagined, we invite you to do it now with Stacey. Go…Speed Racer…Go!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Cash for Clunkers & Easy Upgrades for Fuel Economy
programme.desc: One of the most controversial things to come along recently was the “Cash for Clunkers” program, but do you really know the whole story? Well after this show of GEARZ you will! But Stacey doesn’t just reveal the problems with the Cash for Clunker program, he also demonstrates real solutions available in the aftermarket to address the fuel mileage problem with simple upgrades that ANYBODY can do. If you are tired of feeling like a victim and are ready to do something about your vehicles performance and fuel economy…this is the show to see!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Aftermarket vs. OEM Parts – Welding Techniques for Replacing Sheet Metal
programme.desc: Stacey answers some top questions from viewers as he compares OEM parts to their Aftermarket replacements. Which is the best quality? Which is the best deal? After you see this show, you will know the answer to those questions and a lot more. Then Stacey reveals the tips and techniques involved in welding in replacement sheet metal. If you never thought you could do this kind of major surgery yourself, this show will change your mind and encourage you to get out there and try it! So what are you waiting for? Get movin’!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: ’67 Mercury Cougar disassembly – GMP Diecast story
programme.desc: So you’ve got a new project and you are dying to dig into it huh?..... Well, before you touch it, there are some tips and trick you ought to know before you blow it all apart and end up getting lost in a project you can’t ever finish. Stacey shows you those tips and tricks as he rolls in a Classic ’67 Mercury Cougar and starts methodically taking it apart to prepare it for some wild modifications down the road. If you are considering a project, or are already deep into one, you have got to see this show. Then we take an in depth look at the world of die cast models, as we put the spotlight on GMP and check out their incredible models. So whether you are into toy cars, miniature cars, or the real thing, this episode of GEARZ has something for everybody!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Herobox ’59 Ford Stepside Pickup - Welding Table
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in a ’59 Ford Stepside Truck that is being built by the Herobox organization to help raise awareness for their goal of sending Heroboxes to all of our men and women serving in the Military. It’s a great cause and a great truck and both need to be seen! The truck has already received a lot of modifications, but Stacey adds his special touch by installing custom wood in the bed, trying out a new roll-on bedliner, and sinking some cool 60’s Corvette taillights into the rear fenders. If you’ve got an old truck and have been wondering how to bring the bed and fenders up a notch… this show will definitely give you some ideas! After that, Stacey shows you just how important having the proper work table is, and the kind of things you can do if you have one. It’s all about the tools… it’s all about the techniques… it’s all about GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: If you ask any Gearhead what they dream about doing, being a Blue Angels Jet pilot or an Astronaut will be right at the top of the list. But what is really involved in being a pilot for the Blue Angels? Well today Stacey takes a look at the incredible history of the Blue Angels, and where they are today. Then as only GEARZ can do, Stacey takes you into the cockpit and allows you to experience first hand the incredible experience of flying with the Blue Angels. If sitting on top of thousands of horsepower and flipping inverted at the speed of sound sounds like fun to you… then hold on, because you are in for the ride of your life! If you’ve ever wondered what it was like to be a part of the Blue Angels, and wondered if YOU could ever be a part of the team… this is one show you can’t miss!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Project Heavy Metal & Duramax Diesel Engine Install/Drivetrain
programme.desc: Stacey rolls in that old International Cab over Truck, and starts a project called Heavy Metal. The project not only showcases people that work with their hands for a living, but also represents the Navy’s Blue Angels precision flying team. The first order up for business is to get some serious power into the truck and that involves Stacey stuffing a hot-rodded Duramax Diesel engine and Allison transmission into the old beast. If you have ever wondered what it takes to retro-fit a big diesel engine into a project, and if there are parts available to make it happen… this show will not only answer those questions, but also encourage you to do it!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: Return of the Rat Roaster/Paint and Interior
programme.desc: IT’S BACK!!! The Rat Roaster ’32 Ford roadster rolls back into the GEARZ shop wearing a new coat of green paint and sporting a custom interior… but how did it get that way? Simple, It went for a visit to the Hot Rod Institute in South Dakota, and Stacey takes you there too, as he shows you what makes this tech school so much different than all the others out there. Then Stacey continues putting the finishing touches on this hot ’32 Ford roadster as it makes its way down the final stretch to completion. The baddest car in the valley in 1969 is about to come to life!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.sub-title: The V8 Interceptor – Front suspension on a ’67 Mercury Cougar
programme.desc: One of the most popular cars of the Muscle car era… the Mercury Cougar has been one of the most overlooked cars in recent decades. All of that changes as Stacey rolls in a solid ’67 Cougar, dubs it the “V8 Interceptor”… and begins to completely change the front suspension to get rid of the stock shock towers and turn this little old lady’s car into a corner-carving, road-gripping beast. But wait!... you can’t cut out the shock towers can you!?! Yes you can!... and Stacey goes in-depth on not only how to do it, but also the installation of a complete TCI independent front suspension. If you own or want to own a classic Mustang, Cougar, Fairlane, or other 60’s Ford and have always wished you could get rid of those stock shock towers to get more room in the engine compartment, this is the show for you.

We discuss who might advance and what early performances may tell us about the season ahead. We wrap things up with general thoughts on Doubles, early trends we’re watching, and bold predictions in our Hole-y Hot Take finale.

programme.title: Bienvenidos Season 7 & Pride Month! | Blacktinidad
programme.desc: An all new Blacktinidad look and season, kicking off by celebrating Pride month! We're also joined by Kenny Ervin, David George and Rom Lawrell.

programme.title: In Honor of Juneteenth 2025 | Blacktinidad
programme.desc: Join us for a Juneteenth episode where the hosts discuss the future of the holiday during the current climate, how we will soon be the next "ancestors" and keeping Black history alive for our loved ones.

programme.title: Baby Face Monsters ft. Belissa Escobedo | Lone Lobos
programme.desc: Xolo Maridueña and Jacob Bertrand welcome Belissa Escobedo from DC Comic's Blue Beetle this week on the pod. The crew chug energy drinks, talk about Blue Beetle and the reality of being a baby faced actor.

programme.title: Beige Flags | Lone Lobos
programme.desc: Xolo Maridueña and Jacob Bertrand discuss their red and beige flags for you all to hear. The team also poses the questions: What truths would we want to know? How different are we in private? And what superpowers would we want?

programme.title: The Blue Beetle Episode | Lone Lobos
programme.desc: Xolo talks about his experience working on the Blue Beetle set, sharing scenes with his fellow co-stars such as Susan Sarandon & George Lopez. We get some behind the scenes info on the movie & the team share their thoughts on the movie.

programme.title: Breaking Up 101 | Lone Lobos
programme.desc: Xolo Maridueña and Jacob Bertrand ask each other their burning questions. Also, Xolo helps Jacob learn the art of how to break up with someone.

programme.title: Dancing with Oshun Ramirez and Xochitl Gomez | Lone Lobos
programme.desc: Xóchitl talks with Jacob Bertrand and Xolo Maridueña about being on ABC’S Dancing with The Stars. Xóchitl shares what it was like to join the MCU for Doctor Strange 2 and answers some fan questions.

programme.title: The Last Meal with Peyton List & Joe Seo | Lone Lobos
programme.desc: Xolo Maridueña and Jacob Bertrand share how Peyton and Joe were present for the original podcast demo three years ago. Peyton discusses being behind the camera as a director, her journey joining the Cobra Kai cast.

programme.title: The Chozen One with Yuji Okumoto | Lone Lobos
programme.desc: Yuji Okumoto joins us this week on Lone Lobos. Yuji shares the process of how his character Chozen in Cobra Kai was brought back into the Karate Kid universe, his love of Jordans and his experience owning a restaurant.

programme.title: Special Guest Bruna Marquezine! | Lone Lobos
programme.desc: It’s Lone Lobos quarta-feira. We have Bruna Marquezine this week! Xolo Maridueña and Bruna Marquezine reminisce on their first impressions of each other, talk about Brazil, and cursing em português.

programme.title: Spirituality, Olivia and SZA | Lone Lobos
programme.desc: Xolo and Jacob delve into the spiritual realm. Join us as they explore the world of Tarot cards, discuss vivid dreams involving departed loved ones, and the art of lucid dreaming.

programme.title: Ralph Macchio: The Uncle We Deserve | Lone Lobos
programme.desc: This week on Lone Lobos, Ralph Macchio, to the podcast. Hosts Xolo Maridueña and Jacob Bertrand get candid about working with Ralph as a director.

programme.title: Living in a Horny Olive Land | Lone Lobos
programme.desc: Xolo Maridueña and Jacob Bertrand talk about their experiences in Las Vegas. Jacob also shared some news: he’s got a new home! The team shares stories of using fake names in public. And Xolo and Jacob try out some Jimmy Buffett inspired mad libs.

programme.title: The Jacob and Xolo "Roman Empire" | Lone Lobos
programme.desc: In this season finale, Xolo talks lots of firsts, Jacob shares his personal Roman Empire and whose voice he hears in his inner monologue. Also, the team wonders what it’s like to taste colors.

programme.title: Comedy Legacies & Red Carpet Stars | Blacktinidad
programme.desc: To start off Season 6, we celebrate comedy as a force for healing & unity with comedians Nick Alexander and Michael Baca. Plus, we spotlight the newest films A Fire Inside and Mufasa to celebrate Black talent making waves in the industry.

programme.title: Creating "Her"Story | Blacktinidad
programme.desc: In this episode of Blacktinidad our hosts share powerful conversations on the impact of women breaking barriers. Guests include Cynthia Garcia Williams, Ghislaine Leon, and a special storytelling segment featuring Actor/Comedian Danielle Perez.

programme.title: Content For Social Impact | Blacktinidad
programme.desc: On a new episode of Blacktinidad the hosts are joined by filmmakers Henry Alex and Cristina Sasso.

programme.title: Cuisine, Customs, and Culture | Blacktinidad
programme.desc: Our hosts explore food, customs, and culture and are joined by actor Andresito Germosen and the owner/chef of Bodega Delights to share their journey. Plus, an exclusive two Storyteller segments with Roberto Hannibal and Casa De Lola.

programme.title: Chicago: Volare Restaurant | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis visits Volare, a renowned family-owned Italian restaurant in Chicago, led by Chef Massimo, a Bologna, Italy native. Together, they prepare two of the restaurant’s most popular dishes: squid ink risotto with seafood and tiramisu.

programme.title: Solvang: Peasants Feast | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis explores Solvang, a town with deep Danish heritage in Santa Barbara County on California’s central coast, where she meets Chef Michael Cherney at the beloved Peasants Feast to try their infamous dish: the Copenhagen Caesar Salad.

programme.title: Los Angeles: Yang Chow Restaurant | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis goes to a popular Chinese spot in her hometown to find out what all the hype is about. While Benny, the manager, tells her the interesting story of Yang Chow Restaurant, she enjoys some of the best flavors she’s ever had.

programme.title: Miami: Versailles Restaurant | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis meets her dear friend Luly, Versailles founder’s granddaughter, for a Cuban feast! They talk about the work and sacrifices of the first immigrants in their families and how they carved the path for the following generations.

programme.title: Los Angeles: Mex Peru Gipsy | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Mex Peru Gipsy in Los Angeles was founded by Juan Alfaro in 1882. Chiquis joins Chef Felipe in the kitchen and learns how to make some of the specialties of the house: Tallarin Saltado and Lomo Saltado.

programme.title: Las Vegas: Sayulitas Restaurant | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis visits “Sayulitas” in Las Vegas. A family-owned restaurant that serves traditional Mexican food with a Filipino twist and discovers the inspiring story behind its huge success.

programme.title: Paradise Cove: Malibu’s Comeback Story | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis kicks off the new season at Paradise Cove, a legendary Malibu landmark restaurant. After a devastating January firestorm scorched the coast, owner Tim and Chef Pablo reopened their doors as a symbol of hope for the local community.

programme.title: Las Changas: The Backyard That Became a Movement | Foodie On The Go
programme.desc: Chiquis meets Chef Andrea, whose backyard restaurant in Sylmar, Las Changas, grew out of pandemic hardship and turned into a viral local treasure.

programme.title: San Diego: Abbey's BBQ | Foodie on the Go
programme.desc: Chiquis arrives in sunny San Diego to visit Abbey's BBQ, known for its irresistible brisket. The founders, Matt and Athena, show their decades of BBQ knowledge and leave its legacy to their children, who now run the business.

programme.title: Baja California: Restaurant Luis | Foodie On the Go
programme.desc: Chiquis takes a trip down to Baja California's "Lobster Village" to visit Restaurant Luis! Known for their delicious, fresh lobster!

programme.title: West Hollywood: Yamashiro | Foodie on the Go
programme.desc: Chiquis invites us to one of her favorite Japanese restaurants in LA: Yamashiro. In the 1920's, it was home to the 400 club welcoming celebrities from Hollywood's golden age. This Mansion is full of fresh ingredients and consistent quality.

programme.title: In Search of Food

programme.title: In Search of Food
programme.sub-title: In Search Of Food S01 E06 - San Diego NB
programme.desc: Scott meets committed vegan, farmer and Grammy award winning rock star, Jason Mraz on his southern California avocado farm. Jason has won an Environmental Media Award, a SIMA Humanitarian of the Year Award and A Cleanwater Award from the Surfrider Foundation for his energetic and inspiring commitment to a range of ecological campaigns.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: In the emotionally charged episode host Mike honors a deeply personal commitment to his late father, who passed away from cancer, to seek out the true meaning of happiness. Following this heartfelt promise, we venture to Bhutan, a remarkable country where happiness is not merely an emotion, but a national policy ingrained in its culture. From the lively capital of Thimphu to the peaceful farmlands of Punakha, we explore how Bhutan has seamlessly woven well-being into all aspects of life—from its education system that teaches happiness as a subject to its communities that prioritize collective well-being. This journey serves as both a tribute to Mike's father and an investigation into how Bhutan's unique approach to happiness could offer transformative insights for our own lives. Join us on this poignant and enlightening trip to the Land of the Thunder Dragon as we delve into what happiness truly means, fulfilling a promise and enriching our understanding of life's greatest pursuit.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: A Long Weekend in... With Rory O'Connell
programme.desc: Rory O’Connell’s brand new series combines travel and cookery with the popular chef enjoying the culture as well as the cuisine of eight European cities – Palma de Mallorca, Vienna, Lisbon, Madrid, Bath, Nantes, Copenhagen and Edinburgh. Rory visits a different city in each episode, and while the primary focus is on food, Rory is a knowledgeable guide to so much more, with art and design being particular interests of his. Food becomes much more interesting when seen in context – the culture it is part of the landscape it’s produced in, the history that has influenced it. At the end of each episode, Rory makes a delicious dish with the local produce which he sources on his travels.

programme.title: At Her Majesty's Service
programme.desc: In this series we see Q Elizabeth's official Royal residences, this episode shows the 4,000 ton Royal Yacht Britannia which was retired in 1997. Penelope guides us to the living room, the bed chambers and the Queen's office. The yacht was staffed by over 200 staff. Prince Charles and Lady Dianna had their honeymoon on the yacht, and so did Princess Margaret. The Queen visited over 80 countries while aboard the ship. Then we visit Holyroodhouse in Scotland with the ill fated bed chamber of Mary Queen of Scots.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 62: Dileidi termina con Luis Fernando.
programme.desc: Bueno ya Remedios esta lista par partir, pero no se va sin antes recordarle a Gabriel que ella hizo todo lo posible por reconquistar a su marido, pero no pudo, le da un beso bien contundente a Gabriel y este junto con los demás se sorprenden, ahora Gabriel esta feliz, ya no hay razones para que Gladis lo siga rechazando, prepara la bodega con flores y todo para cuando ella pase por allí como es su costumbre y se tome su cerveza, ya tiene todo listo, Hector sabe que tiene que irse una vez que llegue Gladis, pero en el momento en que se dispone a darle la nueva buena, la llama Marco Aurelio y Gabriel se pone celoso. En la casa de la Nena Gladis le sugiere a su patrona que se busque un millonario de verdad, que con ese porte que ella se manda seguro que lo logra, la Nena no lo cree así. Eglee esta súper curiosa por saber con quien fue Marco Aurelio al concierto, pero éste no le dice nada, le pide cosas que el jamás le ha pedido, esta muy extraño, pero el no le dice nada. Rómulo esta luciéndose con María José, le habla de Lucy, Betzaida esta que se revienta de los celos, los interrumpe por un momento y el prácticamente la ignora, Eglee aprovecha el momento para burlarse de ella, le recuerda que al contrario de ahora, cuando Rómulo era su marido, si es verdad que era aburrido pero también tiene que reconocer que era fiel muy fiel. Al fin Dileidi llama a Luis Fernando, Yenilu esta pendiente para ver si es verdad, pues ya no le cree a su amiga, cuando el contesta el teléfono le reclama que por que no lo había atendido todos estos días, ella le dice que es importante que se vean, el esta muy extrañado pues Dileidi le dice que vaya a pie a la esquina donde siempre el al recoge. La tensión de la muchacha es ahora mayor, dará un paso que para ella es muy triste y doloroso, pero por su mamá hará lo que sea, cuando el llega le pregunta que por que se ven de esa manera, ella palabras mas palabras menos le dice que tiene que terminar la relación con el, Luis Fernando no lo puede creer, le pide perdón si fue que hizo algo malo y el no lo recuerda, le comprueba que se esta portando bien, Dileidi no le puede o no se atreve a decirle la verdadera razón, le dice que no es él sino ella, y cuando Luis Fernando escucha eso, entiende rápido que ella tiene otro, pues ella esta aplicando la misma fórmula que el aplica cuando ya no le interesa para nada una relación, se va furioso y dolido, quedando Dileidi mas confundida que antes, no entiende por que su novio le dice que ella tiene novio, claro es que la muchacha no sabe que hizo sin querer lo que el le hacía a las demás. Cuando Luis Fernando se lo cuenta a su amigo Santiago, este no lo puede creer, a su amigo el galán lo mandaron para el carrizo, hasta se burla, quien seguro sacará provecho de esa situación será Tatiana que ya esta planeando como lo hará y por supuesto que no le dirá nada a Felicita. Quien en ese momento esta hablando de su mamá, bueno en realidad habla sola, por que Pascuita esta mas pendiente de sus supuestas arrugas y de sus supuestos kilos de más, se hará otro refrescamiento pues últimamente siente que su marido esta como muy distraído y ella tiene que hacer lo posible y lo imposible por sacarlo de ese pensamiento. Se le va hacer un poco difícil, pues Monchito cada vez esta mas interesado en Matilde, que si es auténtica y natural, no es frívola ni plástica como su mujer, esta coqueteando con Matilde cuando se aparece Gonzalo y ni cuenta se da de lo que esta pasando con esos dos. Eglee llama a Gladis a la casa de la Nena para que le aclare que es lo que pasa, por que se quiere ir ahora también de la oficina, ya supone que el problema es con ella directamente, pero cuando Gladis contesta se la pasa inmediatamente a la Nena, quien le explica que a ella Gladis no le ha renunciado, al contrario hasta le llevo harina pan y jabón, cuando la Nena le pregunta a Gladis que le esta pasando con Eglee, se enreda toda y le dice un cuento que ni ella misma se cree, cónchale todo por los embustes de su hija y se pregunta a quien abra salido esa muchacha tan mentirosa. La Nena y Theo tienen un encuentro, desagradable y fortuito a la vez, pues el una vez mas hace que su perolito arranque, pero no baja el nivel de agresividad con Theo, busca a Rosa para que la divorcie inmediatamente, ésta se cita con Theo y le da los detalles de lo que será el divorcio, y el muy humildemente le pide que lo retrase un poco, que le de tiempo para poder reconquistar a su mujer. En la casa de Gladis esta le da la buena noticia a su hijo Aleisi con relación a que probablemente pueda estar en una orquesta, pero nota que su hija esta triste, cuando le pregunta el por que de su tristeza, Dileidi le cuenta que ya no tiene que preocuparse, ya ella termino su relación con Luis Fernando, ella una vez mas le dice que ese muchacho no sirve para novio, que ella lo conoce muy bien. El por su parte le cuenta a su papá lo que le paso, Rómulo tampoco entiende pues a el le consta que su hijo estaba portándose bien, Luis Fernando le asegura que cuando una mujer bota a un hombre sin un motivo aparente es por que tiene otro, Rómulo que anda paranoico por que aún no entiende por que Eglee se divorcio de el, no se lo piensa dos veces, entra a la casa bota a Santiago y le echa en cara a Eglee que ella lo boto por Santiago, Eglee se queda entre admirada y pensativa.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 7: El Secreto de Flavia Revelado.
programme.desc: Inés y Jean Paul se apresuran a auxiliar a Luis Guillermo y Diego Andrés quienes se hallan mal heridos tras la riña. Bertha asegurándose de hacerle daño a Flavia revela su secreto ante Michelle y Robert quienes se escandalizan al saber de la existencia de una hermana. Marisela tras su fuga de la casa de los Nuñez piensa en Diego Andrés. Michelle tras saber de la existencia de una hermana se enfrenta a Flavia haciéndole sentir todo su repudio al creerla infiel a su padre. Vicky y Asunta se muestran preocupadas la ignorar lo acontecido por Luis Guillermo y Diego Andrés. En la ciudad de Miami Reinaldo es examinado por el doctor Anselmi quien lo alerta de los riegos de su operación. Jennifer se percata de la ausencia de Marisela al encontrar su nota de despedida.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Inmaculada descubre que quien le robó a su hija cuando la parió fue Ivana. Es por esto que la enfrenta, exigiéndole que le explique por qué se la llevo y encima la descuidó. Vespasiano presencia la pelea y le explota una úlcera, quedando internado unos días. Alejandro es enviado a un barrio alejado en el que supuestamente está escondida Neta. Para su sorpresa se encuentra con Helda, a quién sigue hasta entrar a una casa y ver a la niña. Abril sigue sin perdonar a Alejandro por su traición y le pone todo su esfuerzo y sus ganas al proyecto de clínica que tiene. Karelis intenta mediar entre ella y su hermano, pero no logra nada. Josué sigue afianzando su relación con Ruth, esta vez llevándola a pasar el día al club.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 19: El encuentro de Socorro y Salvador.
programme.desc: Socorro está a punto de ver a Mercedes y Salvador besándose, pero sigue caminando sin siquiera notarlos. Su habitación queda al lado de la de Mercedes y Salvador. Socorro asiste junto con Fernando a su sesión de fotos en la playa privada del hotel. Allí también están su tía y Salvador, pero no se ven.Socorro y Salvador por fin se encuentran más tarde en el ascensor, cuando él baja al restaurante. Ella lo saluda muy feliz y él se queda sin entender nada. No alcanzan a hablar porque en ese instante llega Fernando. Salvador le cuenta a Mercedes de su encuentro y ella se queda preocupada.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Inmaculada descubre que quien le robó a su hija cuando la parió fue Ivana. Es por esto que la enfrenta, exigiéndole que le explique por qué se la llevo y encima la descuidó. Vespasiano presencia la pelea y le explota una úlcera, quedando internado unos días. Alejandro es enviado a un barrio alejado en el que supuestamente está escondida Neta. Para su sorpresa se encuentra con Helda, a quién sigue hasta entrar a una casa y ver a la niña. Abril sigue sin perdonar a Alejandro por su traición y le pone todo su esfuerzo y sus ganas al proyecto de clínica que tiene. Karelis intenta mediar entre ella y su hermano, pero no logra nada. Josué sigue afianzando su relación con Ruth, esta vez llevándola a pasar el día al club.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 19: El encuentro de Socorro y Salvador.
programme.desc: Socorro está a punto de ver a Mercedes y Salvador besándose, pero sigue caminando sin siquiera notarlos. Su habitación queda al lado de la de Mercedes y Salvador. Socorro asiste junto con Fernando a su sesión de fotos en la playa privada del hotel. Allí también están su tía y Salvador, pero no se ven.Socorro y Salvador por fin se encuentran más tarde en el ascensor, cuando él baja al restaurante. Ella lo saluda muy feliz y él se queda sin entender nada. No alcanzan a hablar porque en ese instante llega Fernando. Salvador le cuenta a Mercedes de su encuentro y ella se queda preocupada.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 19: Gabriel, Flavia y la Terapia Inesperada
programme.desc: En la clínica Gabriel y Marisela se sorprenden al ser víctima de los injustificados reproches de Flavia, quien velando por los intereses de su hija Isadora confronta a Gabriel con la realidad de su triste matrimonio, Fernando se hace víctima de la sorpresa y la alegría al reencontrarse con querida hija Marisela. Pantoja y Raiza mantienen su vigilia entorno a Alfonso al llevar en su contra una investigación policial tras sospecharlo incurso en múltiples y turbulentas negociaciones. En la clínica Gabriel se encarga de acrecentar los temores de Flavia al encomendar en manos de Marisela la terapia de rehabilitación de Fernando.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 62: Dileidi termina con Luis Fernando.
programme.desc: Bueno ya Remedios esta lista par partir, pero no se va sin antes recordarle a Gabriel que ella hizo todo lo posible por reconquistar a su marido, pero no pudo, le da un beso bien contundente a Gabriel y este junto con los demás se sorprenden, ahora Gabriel esta feliz, ya no hay razones para que Gladis lo siga rechazando, prepara la bodega con flores y todo para cuando ella pase por allí como es su costumbre y se tome su cerveza, ya tiene todo listo, Hector sabe que tiene que irse una vez que llegue Gladis, pero en el momento en que se dispone a darle la nueva buena, la llama Marco Aurelio y Gabriel se pone celoso. En la casa de la Nena Gladis le sugiere a su patrona que se busque un millonario de verdad, que con ese porte que ella se manda seguro que lo logra, la Nena no lo cree así. Eglee esta súper curiosa por saber con quien fue Marco Aurelio al concierto, pero éste no le dice nada, le pide cosas que el jamás le ha pedido, esta muy extraño, pero el no le dice nada. Rómulo esta luciéndose con María José, le habla de Lucy, Betzaida esta que se revienta de los celos, los interrumpe por un momento y el prácticamente la ignora, Eglee aprovecha el momento para burlarse de ella, le recuerda que al contrario de ahora, cuando Rómulo era su marido, si es verdad que era aburrido pero también tiene que reconocer que era fiel muy fiel. Al fin Dileidi llama a Luis Fernando, Yenilu esta pendiente para ver si es verdad, pues ya no le cree a su amiga, cuando el contesta el teléfono le reclama que por que no lo había atendido todos estos días, ella le dice que es importante que se vean, el esta muy extrañado pues Dileidi le dice que vaya a pie a la esquina donde siempre el al recoge. La tensión de la muchacha es ahora mayor, dará un paso que para ella es muy triste y doloroso, pero por su mamá hará lo que sea, cuando el llega le pregunta que por que se ven de esa manera, ella palabras mas palabras menos le dice que tiene que terminar la relación con el, Luis Fernando no lo puede creer, le pide perdón si fue que hizo algo malo y el no lo recuerda, le comprueba que se esta portando bien, Dileidi no le puede o no se atreve a decirle la verdadera razón, le dice que no es él sino ella, y cuando Luis Fernando escucha eso, entiende rápido que ella tiene otro, pues ella esta aplicando la misma fórmula que el aplica cuando ya no le interesa para nada una relación, se va furioso y dolido, quedando Dileidi mas confundida que antes, no entiende por que su novio le dice que ella tiene novio, claro es que la muchacha no sabe que hizo sin querer lo que el le hacía a las demás. Cuando Luis Fernando se lo cuenta a su amigo Santiago, este no lo puede creer, a su amigo el galán lo mandaron para el carrizo, hasta se burla, quien seguro sacará provecho de esa situación será Tatiana que ya esta planeando como lo hará y por supuesto que no le dirá nada a Felicita. Quien en ese momento esta hablando de su mamá, bueno en realidad habla sola, por que Pascuita esta mas pendiente de sus supuestas arrugas y de sus supuestos kilos de más, se hará otro refrescamiento pues últimamente siente que su marido esta como muy distraído y ella tiene que hacer lo posible y lo imposible por sacarlo de ese pensamiento. Se le va hacer un poco difícil, pues Monchito cada vez esta mas interesado en Matilde, que si es auténtica y natural, no es frívola ni plástica como su mujer, esta coqueteando con Matilde cuando se aparece Gonzalo y ni cuenta se da de lo que esta pasando con esos dos. Eglee llama a Gladis a la casa de la Nena para que le aclare que es lo que pasa, por que se quiere ir ahora también de la oficina, ya supone que el problema es con ella directamente, pero cuando Gladis contesta se la pasa inmediatamente a la Nena, quien le explica que a ella Gladis no le ha renunciado, al contrario hasta le llevo harina pan y jabón, cuando la Nena le pregunta a Gladis que le esta pasando con Eglee, se enreda toda y le dice un cuento que ni ella misma se cree, cónchale todo por los embustes de su hija y se pregunta a quien abra salido esa muchacha tan mentirosa. La Nena y Theo tienen un encuentro, desagradable y fortuito a la vez, pues el una vez mas hace que su perolito arranque, pero no baja el nivel de agresividad con Theo, busca a Rosa para que la divorcie inmediatamente, ésta se cita con Theo y le da los detalles de lo que será el divorcio, y el muy humildemente le pide que lo retrase un poco, que le de tiempo para poder reconquistar a su mujer. En la casa de Gladis esta le da la buena noticia a su hijo Aleisi con relación a que probablemente pueda estar en una orquesta, pero nota que su hija esta triste, cuando le pregunta el por que de su tristeza, Dileidi le cuenta que ya no tiene que preocuparse, ya ella termino su relación con Luis Fernando, ella una vez mas le dice que ese muchacho no sirve para novio, que ella lo conoce muy bien. El por su parte le cuenta a su papá lo que le paso, Rómulo tampoco entiende pues a el le consta que su hijo estaba portándose bien, Luis Fernando le asegura que cuando una mujer bota a un hombre sin un motivo aparente es por que tiene otro, Rómulo que anda paranoico por que aún no entiende por que Eglee se divorcio de el, no se lo piensa dos veces, entra a la casa bota a Santiago y le echa en cara a Eglee que ella lo boto por Santiago, Eglee se queda entre admirada y pensativa.

programme.desc: Inés y Jean Paul se apresuran a auxiliar a Luis Guillermo y Diego Andrés quienes se hallan mal heridos tras la riña. programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Helda enfrenta a Alejandro y sigue firme en su postura. Le dice al detective que todo lo que supone sobre la niña Neta es una mentira. Ivana los escucha hablando y pregunta sobre el asunto. Sin embargo, decide creerle a su mucama. Julio no quiere que Vanesa vaya al encuentro de la viuda negra. Es por eso que se ofrece ir él en su lugar. Como Vanesa no acepta, él va al lugar de encuentro, y todos los policías lo rodean, pensando que él es el asesino tan buscado. Ivana se siente traicionada por Ángel ya que él le dijo la verdad sobre su hija a Inmaculada. A su vez, enfrenta a Julio, diciéndole que se encargue solamente de buscar a Neta. Si él lo lograra, cuando Inmaculada se aleje por fin de la familia, la niña regresaría s su vida normal.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 20: Socorro y el plan de Josefina
programme.desc: Socorro, impactada, saluda a su tía mientras mira con odio a Salvador. Mercedes le pide que no cuente nada, ella aparenta tranquilidad y se devuelve a su habitación. A solas, llora de la ira, busca a Fernando y lo besa. Salvador se da cuenta y la ignora. Socorro se aleja de Fernando, quien sorprendido no entiende nada. Josefina planea con Gonzalo, cómo inventar que su hija este embarazada sin que nadie se dé cuenta de la farsa. Piensan en adoptar un bebé. Isabel le pide disculpas a Josefina y le cuenta que la relación que tenía con Julio César ya se acabó pero que además, no quiere terminar con la amistad que tiene con Socorro.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Mekong River, Vietnam: On the river, Tony drinks a lot of Mekong moonshine with the welcoming owners of a duck farm. Although seduced by his Vietnam experience, Tony is not sure the royal dish Birds Nest Soup is all its cracked up to be.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: The Struggle for the Soul of America
programme.desc: Tony travels to the grain-belt capital of Minneapolis, Minnesota to experience firsthand the conflict between creative independent operators and generic franchises.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Arcachon, France: Here, Bourdain first learned to love food as a child. Returning for a trip down memory lane, Tony enjoys childhood staples, including steak frites, gaufres (waffles), soupe de pecheur (fisherman's soup) and fresh oysters.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: No Beads, No Babes, No Bourbon Street
programme.desc: In New Orleans, Louisiana, Tony catches a Bayou alligator, cools off with a world-famous snow cone, gets in trouble with the law, eats jambalaya with a dancing chef, and relaxes to some local jazz.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: The Cook Who Came in From the Cold
programme.desc: St. Petersburg, Russia: Tony plays spy in Russia and sets off to locate the best blinis and borscht St. Petersburg has to offer.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Food Tastes Better with Sand Between Your Toes
programme.desc: In the Caribbean paradise of St. Martin, Tony eats a healthy Rastafarian meal with a freedom fighter, helps prepare grub for a food caravan, discovers foodstuffs not available at American supermarkets, and finally relaxes at a beach bar.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Scotland: Beginning in Glasgow, Tony experiences the heart-clogging glory of deep fried pizza, deep fried mars bars, and deep fried pickled eggs! Moving on to more traditional fare, Tony tastes haggis and learns to hunt and fish for his food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Cambodia: With a friend along for the ride, Tony travels to Phnom Penh, Cambodia, where he explores a food culture that is both pleasing to the palette and slightly frightening.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Eating on the Edge of Nowhere
programme.desc: Cambodia and Japan: Taking his obsession with the film Apocalypse Now a little too seriously, Tony sets out for Pailin, reputed to be one of the most dangerous towns on earth. After his journey, Tony returns to Japan.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Cobra Heart-Food That Makes You Manly
programme.desc: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam: After taking a cyclo-ride through Ho Chi Minh City and trying various foods from roadside vendors and markets, Tony tests his might with a few shots of snake wine and a live cobra heart.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Oaxaca, Mexico: Chef Tony Bourdain explores the exotic and colorful indigenous zone of Mexico's Oaxaca region where he tastes toasted grasshoppers and other delicacies. His adventure ends with mariachi music and, of course, lots of tequila.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Morocco (Sahara): Tony traverses the Moroccan desert with one goal in mind, to eat a mud-oven-roasted sheep.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Alila Villas Uluwatu is a magical 5-star resort set atop steep cliffs overlooking the Indian Ocean. Executive Chef Stephane Simond prepares stunning dishes served at Alila's two high end restaurants CIRE and The Warung.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Phil makes a grand entrance onto the beach in front of the equally grand Sakala Beach Club where Frederic Boulay introduces us to the restaurant's amazing signature dishes, and the tranquil accommodations found in this exquisite resort.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Professional Mixologist Jonas Ax reveals his depth of knowledge of all things shaken, stirred, chilled, and sparkling as host Phillip Davenport spends an afternoon at Elysium Bar and Terrace.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: In the Yucatan, cooking over fire is a way of life, and Chefs Juan Pablo Loza, Federico Lopez, and Eric Werner demonstrate their mastery cooking with flame. Back at Lena Brava in Chicago, Rick prepares spatchcock chicken al oregano.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Rick and his daughter, Lanie, check out Mexico's real-life superhero subculture: the surreal, splashy world of Lucha Libre. The beloved masked wrestling phenomenon captured all of Mexico's imagination and became embraced by its' culture.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: The Baja California peninsula boasts a climate reminiscent of the Mediterranean Sea. Rick makes tacos with ingredients from the gardens of the Rancho La Puerta spa, and meets up with Chefs Miguel Angel Guerrero Yagues and Jair Tellez.

programme.title: Rituals of the World
programme.desc: Simply put, "Ukuli Bula" is a bull jumping ceremony. The idea for those who participate is to perform three consecutive jumps over three large bulls, without falling over. If the young man, or "Ukuli," fails in his endeavor, he will be mocked by the village, and will not be allowed to marry.

programme.title: Rituals of the World
programme.desc: The tattooing practiced in Samoa is not comparable to the fashionable trend in Europe. In Samoa, tattooing is above all a rite signifying that the individual belongs to a group, and it is extremely painful. The more painful it is, the more Stivi approaches the state of a real, accomplished man.

programme.title: Rituals of the World
programme.desc: Holy Week is among the most important rituals in Christianity. The week before Easter, Holy Week celebrates the death and resurrection of Jesus Christ. In Seville, Spain, from Palm Sunday to Easter Sunday, dozens of processions take place, each one led by one of the 60 brotherhoods in the city.

programme.title: Secrets of the National Parks
programme.desc: Hawaii Volcanoes and Haleakala National Parks are two of the most extraordinary places on Earth. Here you can witness molten lava bubbling from the earth, catch a spectacular sunrise above the cloud-line, or take a dip into pools of paradise.

programme.title: Green Paradise
programme.sub-title: Morocco - The Magic of the Great South
programme.desc: The sands of the Moroccan Desert rhythmically dance across a vast, ethereal landscape. This immense region of parched sand and rock appears frozen for eternity, but it is not, as the dunes of the desert are ever being carefully shaped and transformed by the capricious winds of time.

programme.title: The Green Wave
programme.desc: Sao Tome and Principe are two African islands on the Equator that are striving for sustainability. Here, the inspiring work of environmentalists and local people are helping to establish balance between development and natural resources.

programme.title: Lonely Planet: Best Parks Ever - America's National Parks
programme.sub-title: Best Parks for Jaw Dropping Scenery
programme.desc: See Mother Nature at its best. From the highest waterfall to the one of the biggest holes in the world, it's this kind of scenery that will make you stop in your tracks.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi

programme.title: Laura McKenzie's Traveler
programme.desc: Board a private mega-yacht with seafarer Laura McKenzie, and cruise the deep blue waters of the Mediterranean Sea in style. You will visit Greece, the land of the sun and the gods, and the islands of Hydra, Malta, and Sicily.

programme.desc: First stops are Camden Market and Notting Hill Gate. Enjoy a treat as Laura escorts you to the birthplace of pomp and circumstance, Buckingham Palace. Then mosey down to Windsor Castle before taking on London with Big Ben and Tower Bridge.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Tamales are Rick's idea of the perfect party food. In Mexico, when family and friends get together for a tamalada, the cooking is as much a part of the celebration as the eating. Rick shows viewers how to pull off a tamalada for a crowd.

programme.title: Ottolenghi's Mediterranean Feast

programme.title: Mythical Roads
programme.sub-title: The Route of the Two Oceans
programme.desc: The thin ridge that links the two Americas is a miniature world unto itself and concentrates a vast amount of diversity into a small area of land. Follow the Inter-American Highway from Panama City to the Isthmus of Rivas in Nicaragua, the narrowest ridge of Central America.

programme.title: Mythical Roads
programme.desc: For almost half a century, Europe was demonstrably divided into East and West by the "Iron Curtain," an imaginary, yet strongly re-enforced, barrier separating Europe that stretched between the Barents and Black Seas. programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation
programme.desc: The year-end Junior Formal is fast approaching, and Marco is in charge, except when it comes to a date. Problem is, Marco’s too nervous to ask Dylan out at all, let alone ask him to the prom.

programme.title: Degrassi: The Next Generation

programme.title: FinQuest
programme.desc: In Episode 3 of FinQuest, Ryan Miller joins Captain Alex from Supremacy Fishing Charters for an offshore adventure targeting big fish off shore. Starting at the Palm Beach Inlet, the team uses planar fishing techniques to hook wahoo and other catches like kingfish and amberjack. Along the way, firefighter Johnny Bennett shares his journey from fishing to starting a popular fish dip business. The day wraps up with thrilling doubleheader catches and a conservation message, showcasing the importance of sustainable fishing practices.

programme.title: FinQuest
programme.sub-title: "One Fish Two Fish Red Fish Blue Fish"
programme.desc: In Episode 6 of FinQuest, Ryan Miller dives into the vibrant world of offshore fishing off the coast of Palm Beach County. Joined by Cabo Mike and Chi Lui they showcase expert bait techniques and strategies for trolling and reef fishing. The team reels in a variety of fish, including snapper, mackerel, porgy, blue fish. Cabo Mike goes over the hook set ups they used and equipment tips. With breathtaking views of the ocean and a colorful array of fish, Ryan’s passion for saltwater fishing shines through. The episode wraps up with Ryan meeting up with Mandy & Hawkin to ice skate – outside – in Palm Beach County FL.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA was introduced to the shooting sports world. Since that day, an immeasurable number of AA hulls have hit the ground and countless shooters have stood center stage raising a trophy where millions of dollars have been won. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell. - GUESTS: Zach Keenbaum (Team Winchester) Desi Edmunds (Team Winchester) Kayla Wilgus (Team Winchester) Amy Cawley (Team Winchester) Anthony Matarese (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: For the first time in history, the World English Sporting Clays Championship was held in the United States at the incredible M&M Hunting Preserve owned by the Matarese family in New Jersey. Watch as Winchester’s best shooters vie for Gold as they compete against over 2,500 shooters and 17 countries. We’ll also join the Kids and Clays foundation in Florida as they host an event that will most certainly touch your soul.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Across the country, deer season to many Americans is a rite of passage. For generations, Winchester has been the trusted ammunition choice for hunters…and it’s been a decade since the game-changing Deer Season XP whitetail line was introduced. In this episode, we’ll celebrate the many successes by Team Winchester hunters in the field during whitetail and mule deer firearm seasons across the United States. - GUESTS: Melissa Bachman (Team Winchester) Mark Drury (Team Winchester) Nikki Boxler (Team Winchester) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester) Jason Gilbertson (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The mission of Shoot United is to be a content resource for millions of shooters and a place where people can learn, build confidence and find ways to participate. Through films, educational videos and articles, SU has impacted countless shooters all over the world. In this episode, join Shoot United Ambassadors as they inspire and educate through a series of instructional videos and stories in pistol, self-defense, trap and skeet and sporting clays. - GUESTS: Thea Van Sync (Team Winchester) Callie Farill (Team Winchester) Becky Yackley (Team Winchester) Theo Ribbs (Team Winchester) Jessica Hook (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Is Colorado a Food Utopia? Exploring Farm to Table Cuisine, Epic Landscapes & UFO's"
programme.desc: Everyone knows Colorado for its epic mountains and fresh powder. But on this episode of DIRT, we’re digging into the unexpected side of the state (UFO rumors and all). Whether surfing infinite river waves, cultivating perfect carrot seeds, or fly fishing in downtown Denver’s shadow—geeky passions run high. Follow along as we gather ingredients for a farm to table final feast equal parts foraged, free-range, and free-thinking.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Exploring New Zealand’s Wild Flavors, Māori Culture & Volcanic Hot Spring Cooking"
programme.desc: They say you come to New Zealand as a stranger, but leave as family. In this episode of DIRT, the crew goes full circle—meeting Muttonbird chefs Emma and George on the South Island before hopping up to Raglan and working their way back down. Water skiing next to snow-capped mountains, cooking in hot springs the Māori way, and stargazing at Wairarapa Dark Sky Reserve are all on the itinerary. But it’s the final “Feed” done Kiwi-style that makes one thing clear—in this unique and stunning land, nobody’s a stranger for long.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Can You Forage, Fish & Feast Like a Local in Seattle in 48 Hours?"
programme.desc: Episode one hits close to home. Specifically, Josh’s hometown of Seattle where we travel from the mountains to the coast in pursuit of local ingredients for an authentic Washington meal. Digging for forest delicacies, hunting for exotic bivalves, and exploring the tidal flats of a multi-generational shellfish farm—it’s all on the menu.

programme.desc: Sebastian, dodging Anton's shots, takes Amelia to the hospital. There, their baby is born. Fausto takes Ezequiel again as his hostage. Fausto and Patricia are thrilled to meet their grandson and Amelia asks her father to honor his word to let Ezequiel go free.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel feels betrayed and hands over his daughter to the infamous Celso who intends to abuse her. Sebastian saves her from the incident. programme.title: Piel Salvaje

Elda, who receives flowers from Alfredo, fears that Luciano will discover her.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fernando threatens Jeli with taking the child, but Leandro warns him that he is his father. programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.title: Piel Salvaje

programme.title: Accomplice to Murder, With Vinnie Politan

programme.title: Trial & Error: Why Did O.J. Win?

programme.title: Accomplice to Murder, With Vinnie Politan
programme.sub-title: FL v. Trexler: the Hairdresser, the Hitman, and the Grandmother

programme.title: Accomplice to Murder, With Vinnie Politan

programme.title: Gwyneth Paltrow Ski Crash Case

programme.title: Gwyneth Paltrow Ski Crash Case
programme.desc: For a man who experienced a serious closed head injury which involves memory loss, Terry Sanderson is asked to recall what he remembers in the moments leading up to the ski crash.

programme.title: Gwyneth Paltrow Ski Crash Case
programme.desc: Sanderson says he was hit from behind on a ski slope and was not helped at the crash scene; he gives emotional testimony about the changes he says happened in his life following the 2016 accident.

programme.title: Gwyneth Paltrow Ski Crash Case
programme.desc: According to Terry Sanderson, he had been working hard to improve his cognitive and behaviorial issues following the crash with Gwyneth Paltrow. He told the jury that he wanted to believe he fully recover and go back to being the person that he was.

programme.title: Gwyneth Paltrow Ski Crash Case
programme.desc: The jurors who would decide the Gwyneth Paltrow ski crash case listened to the plaintiff, Terry Sanderson, tell his side of the story. Its first witness was a seasoned ski instructor who was hired by Paltrow's family.

programme.title: Gwyneth Paltrow Ski Crash Case
programme.desc: This ski instructor didn't see the collision, but he was on the slope and saw the moments before and after. He testified that Terry Sanderson apologized several times to his client, Gwyneth Paltrow at the crash scene.

programme.title: Gwyneth Paltrow Ski Crash Case
programme.sub-title: Interaction At The Ski Crash Scene
programme.desc: The ski instructor, who was working with Gwyneth Paltrow the day of the collision with Terry Sanderson, disagreed with his account of what happened immediately after the crash. Eric claimed he was the very last person to leave the crash scene.

programme.title: TikTok Star Murder Trial
programme.desc: Jurors had been learning about the evidence against the defendant, Ali Abulaban. He was accused of the premeditated murder of his estranged wife, Ana, and her friend Rayburn Barron. Both were shot in the face at close range.

programme.title: TikTok Star Murder Trial
programme.desc: According to her friend, physical, mental, and verbal abuse had been a part of Ana Abulaban's home life with her husband before she died.

programme.title: TikTok Star Murder Trial
programme.desc: The jury learned more about the issues in the relationship between the defendant and his wife, Ana. Months before she and her friend Rayburn Barron were killed, she was allegedly beaten, harassed, and even stalked by Ali.

programme.title: TikTok Star Murder Trial
programme.desc: Another close friend of Ana Abulaban took the stand. Prosecutors wanted to portray the defendant, Ali Abulaban, as an abusive, jealous, out-of-control husband whose behavior led him to plot and kill his wife, Ana, and her friend, Rayburn Barron.

programme.title: TikTok Star Murder Trial

programme.title: Someone They Knew with Tamron Hall

programme.title: Someone They Knew with Tamron Hall

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

programme.title: Blitzed: The 80s Blitz Kids Story
programme.desc: Boy George was the coat check girl (admittedly stealing money from the purses) .... Bowie, synth beats, and a new freedom of sexual identity were in the air. The Blitz Club spell was cast and a hotbed of talent emerged: Ultravox, Spandau Ballet, Culture Club, Sade, and practically everyone else you've ever heard from the era.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell
programme.desc: In the 1970's Hollywood began to release a whole new type of musical film. Bob Fosse, Hippies, and Jesus were the new stars in this adventurous period in cinema.

programme.title: SPIN Presents: Trailers From Hell

programme.title: Stone Roses - Made Of Stone
programme.desc: In 2012, a resurrection no one thought possible took place when legendary band, The Stone Roses reformed after 16 years. With unprecedented access to previously unseen archive footage, MADE OF STONE is a revealing journey through the life of one of the most revered and influential bands in British music history.

programme.title: Looking for Johnny: The Legend of Johnny Thunders
programme.desc: Johnny Thunders was the legendary hard-living rock n roll guitarist who inspired glam-metal, punk and the music scene in general. Looking For Johnny is a 90-minute film that documents Thunders career from his beginnings to his tragic death in 1991. The film examines his career as a member of the New York Dolls, the punk scene with The Heartbreakers in New York City and London and much more.

programme.title: Johnny Thunders - Madrid Memory
programme.desc: A long lost live concert performance from The Heartbreakers explosive 1984 reunion world tour that included fellow Dolls Sylvain Sylvain & Jerry Nolan plus Billy Rath! Filmed for TV broadcast at La Edad De Oro in Madrid, Spain, this concert captures powerful performances of songs from throughout Thunders's amazing career including Personality Crisis, Too Much Junkie Business, Born Too Lose

programme.title: MOD SUN Interview: Walk With Me | SPIN Cover Story
programme.desc: No doubt MOD’s lived many lives since Happy To Be Here was first published in 2015, stating that he feels fortunate to have accomplished so much of what he’d set out to do. His main goal is to keep evolving.
